note: Test-id ledger for the engine-split task 1e-M (the fold version split into MAJOR and MINOR, D34), built against base 115b7b573 (main after 1e). Ids are relative to each collection ROOT. Run: node scripts/lib/test-parity.mjs --before <before-engine.json>=<base>/packages/engine --before <before-matrix.json>=<base>/tools/matrix --before <before-scripts.json>=<base> --after <after-engine.json>=packages/engine --after <after-matrix.json>=tools/matrix --after <after-scripts.json>=. --ledger this-file. No existing test id changed or was retired: 30 tests are added (5 in src/sport/fold-epoch.test.ts, 14 in test/fold-epoch-guard.test.ts, 11 in test/fold-epoch-guard-cli.test.ts). Existing tests whose bodies changed keep their titles: the report-line regexes of the CLI tests moved to the new line format, one real-corpus sweep and one toEqual learned the new row fields, and the table differential test now rewrites both tables.
